title: Virginia and D.C. sue to block construction of Trump arch
content: U.S. District Court Judge Tanya Chutkin ordered both sides to talk and to agree on a proposed briefing schedule on the motion for a temporary restraining order by Saturday evening.

title: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
content: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices.  For now at least, interest rates are staying the same.  What does that mean for the midterm elections?

title: France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe
content: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned of a "very high risk" of disorder, especially after dark on Halloween, as some 320,000 people nationwide took to the streets.

title: Key takeaways from this week's political meeting in Beijing
content: The Communist party central committee meeting was focused on discipline and fighting corruption. It comes ahead of next year when Xi is widely expected to try to secure a fourth term.

title: A simple explainer of the massive $6.3 billion crypto heist at Binance
content: Here are five things to know about the massive hack of the crypto exchange Binance — from how it happened to what it means for the sector.

title: Justice Department seeks to isolate Alaska ballots amid criminal probe over Senate candidate
content: The latest developments come amid allegations, first reported by The New York Times, that Democrats recruited a spoiler candidate in the toss-up U.S. Senate race.

title: Perspective: Forget the ballroom, we're headed to Cheesecake Factory!
content: Former President Obama caused a kerfuffle with his comments about President Trump's interior decorating at the White House. But maybe state dinners should happen at The Cheesecake Factory.

title: Drone photo award winners: Far-out landscapes. Ship recycling. Rugs, rugs rugs!
content: The Siena Drone Photo Awards for 2026 offer breathtaking bird's-eye views of our planet, revealing landscapes, livelihoods and human stories often invisible from the ground.

title: Do you have seasonal affective disorder? How to tell — and what to do about it
content: The syndrome can make people feel like a "hibernating bear," says Dr. Norman Rosenthal, who published the first research on SAD. He explains how to identify the symptoms and what to do to feel better.

title: Your writing was flagged as AI. What does that actually mean?
content: As editors turn to imperfect AI detection tools to weed out machine-generated submissions, writers who say they were falsely accused of using AI are left wondering what triggered a positive result.
